description: Source code for a real-time timing notifier in a radio communication system, implementing GPS time synchronization, symbol and slot timing, and notifier subscription management.

classes.name: gps_clock
classes.description: A custom GPS clock implementation providing current time adjusted for GPS offset.

methods.name: calculate_ns_fraction_from
methods.description: Calculates the fractional nanoseconds within a second from a GPS clock time point.

methods.name: get_symbol_index
methods.description: Calculates the symbol index within a second based on fractional nanoseconds and symbol duration.

methods.name: get_current_system_slot
methods.description: Determines the current system slot based on GPS time, slot duration, and hyper system frame slots.

methods.name: circular_distance
methods.description: Calculates the distance between two values with wrap-around consideration.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the real-time timing notifier, initializing timing loop and synchronization.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the timing notifier, waits for thread termination, and clears notifiers.

methods.name: timing_loop
methods.description: Main loop executing periodic polling for symbol and slot timing.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Performs timing calculations, detects missed symbols, and notifies subscribers.

methods.name: notify_slot_symbol_point
methods.description: Notifies all subscribed notifiers of a new symbol point.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes notifiers to receive timing updates.
